slides.meta: Tudor Black Bay GMT vs Cartier Santos-Dumont

slides.headline: Black Bay GMT is a steel sports watch
slides.body: Its red and blue rotating bezel tracks a second time zone. US price $5,275.

slides.headline: Santos-Dumont is named for an aviator
slides.body: This square steel Cartier honours Alberto Santos-Dumont, a Brazilian pioneer of flight. US price $5,250.
